description: Maps discovered functionality to OWASP Top 10 2021 categories and representative CWEs. The AI must only use these mappings; it must never invent new vulnerabilities.

A01:2021-Broken Access Control.description: Access control enforces policy such that users cannot act outside of their intended permissions.

A02:2021-Cryptographic Failures.description: Failures related to cryptography (or lack of it) that lead to sensitive data exposure.

A03:2021-Injection.description: User-supplied data is sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query.

A04:2021-Insecure Design.description: A collection of weaknesses related to design and architectural flaws.

A05:2021-Security Misconfiguration.description: Missing or insecure security hardening across the application stack.

A06:2021-Vulnerable and Outdated Compone.description: Using components with known vulnerabilities or that are out of support.

A07:2021-Identification and Authenticati.description: Functionality related to authentication and session management can be circumvented or abused.

A08:2021-Software and Data Integrity Fai.description: Code and infrastructure that do not protect against integrity violations.

A09:2021-Security Logging and Monitoring.description: Insufficient logging and monitoring allows attackers to advance attacks undetected.

A10:2021-Server-Side Request Forgery (SS.description: The web application fetches a remote resource without validating the user-supplied URL.
